alisa: Heads-up — meeting with Snowflake partner PM moved to tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: connector listing, marketplace listing, joint announcement timing.
ben-p: ack. Can we confirm technical owner for the Snowflake connector? Who's on eng side?
maria-sd: @ben-p I can own Snowflake connector integration. Will need a contact at their connectors team. Also need review for our ODBC/SQL flow and COPY support.
ben-p: thx. @rahul can you scope the Databricks side? Need info on Unity Catalog and cluster access model.
rahul: I'll take Databricks. Quick q: can we require customers to provide token + role? Databricks prefers workspace tokens.
alisa: note: marketplace listing requires legal to sign MSA addendum. @jess can you loop in legal today?
jess: looping legal ops now. Also need approved logos and blurb — marketing to draft.
maria-sd: for vector DBs, patching in Weaviate / Pinecone via generic vector connector. We should build an adapter interface: config like:
```json
{
  "type": "vector",
  "endpoint": "https://api.pinecone.io",
  "api_key": "<secret>",
  "namespace": "redwood-llm"
}
```
ben-p: looks good. We should expose baked-in transforms for Snowflake->embedding pipeline: sample SQL, export to S3, run batch embed job. Put this in docs.
marketplace-bot: Reminder — marketplace listing template due in 3 business days: https://intranet/redwood/marketplace-template
alisa: Next steps: Maria owns Snowflake, Rahul owns Databricks, Ben owns connector adapter API, Jess owns legal + marketing. Deliverables by EOD Friday. Anyone blocked?
rahul: blocked on Databricks Unity Catalog access for test workspace. I'll ping partner dev rep.
maria-sd: blocked on sample datasets from Snowflake partner. @alisa can you request?
alisa: asked partner contact to share sample dataset link, cc'd in email.
ben-p: I'll draft PR for connector interface and initial docs. ETA Thu.
maria-sd: I'll sketch integration test plan and token requirement matrix.
jess: legal acknowledged — expect review within 48 hrs.
alisa: great. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
